sources.notes: Concept personally inspected: retain high tributary trough, cliff lip and waterfall above deeper broad main trough. Right side tributary runs from outer+X flank into main trough atX12, y8; floor16m versus main4m; flat main floor width18m and steep shoulders up24m. Use original faceted heightfield with explicitly vertical lip, side/underside closure and finite opaque water volume. Omit tiny vegetation/photo-like texture and secondary stream detail. No glacier, rocks floating over lip, arrows or base plinth. Not another orientation of simple U valley: height difference and tributary are essential.
